meta.name: mem-search
meta.description: Search claude-mem's persistent cross-session memory database. Use when user asks "did we already solve this?", "how did we do X last time?", or needs work from previous sessions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把之前交流时确定的方案和说法直接找回来
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常和AI助手连续协作,却不时忘记上次聊过的结论
copy.tagline_en: Bring back the solution discussed in a previous session with one question
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often work with an AI assistant across sessions and forget past conclusions

howto.what: Claude 会检索 claude-mem 保存的跨会话记忆：先用 search 拿到带 ID 的结果索引，用 timeline 看上下文，只对筛出的条目取完整详情；必要时才取原始工具输入输出。
howto.when: 当你问的是之前会话而不是当前对话时触发，例如「这个问题之前解决过吗」「上次是怎么做 X 的」等。

say.text: 我们之前解决过这个问题吗？搜一下记忆
say.note: 会先搜记忆索引，再据此回答

say.text: 上周那个迁移报错最后是怎么处理的？
say.note: 取详情，必要时才给原始输出

say.text: 用 /knowledge-agent 把记忆整理成可问答的资料库
say.note: 基于历史观察构建可查询语料

howto.what_en: Claude searches claude-mem's cross-session memory: it first runs search to get an index of results with IDs, then timeline for context, and fetches full details only for selected IDs; raw tool I/O only when needed.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask about previous sessions rather than the current conversation, e.g. "did we already solve this?" or "how did we do X last time?".

say_en.text: Did we already solve this? Search the memory.
say_en.note: Searches the memory index first, then answers

say_en.text: How did we fix last week's migration failure?
say_en.note: Fetches details; raw output only if needed
